MR RUTVIJ OZA, APP for the PETITIONER(s) No. 1 MR DK MODI(1317) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1,2,3 MR MD MODI(1318) for the RESPONDENT(s) No. 1,2,3 ==========================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR.JUSTICE B.N. KARIA
Date : 08/09/2018  ORAL ORDER 1.

This Criminal Appeal preferred under Section 378(1)(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 against the judgment and order of acquittal dated 30.04.2015 rendered by learned 3rd Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Anand in Criminal Case No. 1139/2009 under the provisions of Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, 1954.
2. This Appeal is taken up for settlement in Lok Adalat.
3. Mr. Rutvij Oza, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has appeared on behalf of the State and has produced withdrawal / settlement pursis, which is taken on record.

The withdrawal /
R/CR.A/1375/2015 ORDER settlement pursis is signed by APP Shri Rutvij Oza, Mr. B. P. Sharma,
Food Safety Officer on behalf of the appellant and learned advocate for the respondent no.1.

All the concerned are present in person before this Lok Adalat, and the pursis is counter signed by learned State Of Gujarat Thro' Kirtikumar ... vs Hitendrasinh Babubhai Jadeja on 8 September, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41082677/

entities.text: State Of Gujarat Thro' Kirtikumar ... vs Hitendrasinh Babubhai Jadeja
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 1 APP and respective learned advocates.

4. It is submitted that the offence alleged against the accused under the Prevention of Food Adulteration Act, is not serious in nature, the penalty / punishment prescribed for such offence is not substantial in view of the Sections 51 and 52 of the Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006, it is compoundable under Section 69 of the said Act.
5. In view of the withdrawal / compromise pursis of the parties, this Appeal stands disposed of.
The respondents No.1 and 2

are directed to pay a sum of Rs. 3,000/- (Rupees Three thousand only) each and respondent no. 3 is directed to pay a sum of Rs. 5,000/- (Rupees Five thousand only), in all Rs.
11,000/- towards litigation cost; as agreed between the parties.

Necessary cost be deposited in the office of the High Court Legal Services Committee within four weeks, failing which the Appeal shall stand revived automatically and the said amount be transmitted to the concerned office of the Assistant Commissioner, Nadiad.
Accordingly, this appeal stands disposed of.

However, disposal of this matter will not affect any connected matters arising out of the same,
incidental or any other proceedings, filed or to be filed before any other Court.
It is also required to be noted that this order will not be treated as a precedent in any future case for reference.
(B.N. KARIA, J.) Chairman ksdarji State Of Gujarat Thro' Kirtikumar ... vs Hitendrasinh Babubhai Jadeja on 8 September, 2018 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/41082677/
